title: Everyday Talk
author: Hive
intro: 这一课练的是日常聊天：问候、聊天气、说周末计划和日常习惯。前四句是练习的起点，先慢慢读清每个词，再把后面的句子连起来读顺，最后可以试着用自己的生活替换句子里的内容。
tips: 句末语调下降，句中逗号处停顿半拍，不要一口气读完。
I'm、it's 这类缩写读得轻快自然，不必把每个音都读满。
segments: I usually read a little every evening. Today, I want to improve my English pronunciation.
I enjoy building small games and learning how things work. I am practicing English a little every day.
This weekend, I would like to take a walk, visit a bookstore, and spend some time with my friends.
I built this project from scratch. First, I made a simple prototype. Then, I tested the main features and improved the design.
Good morning! It's a bit cold today, so I'm wearing my warm jacket.
What are you doing this weekend? I'm going to visit my grandparents on Saturday.
I usually get up at seven, and I have a cup of tea before breakfast. After work, I like to go for a short run.
Sorry I'm late. The bus was full, so I decided to walk the rest of the way.
Did you sleep well last night? I stayed up too late watching a movie, so I'm a little tired.
